name: Relic Island — The Stranded Home

placement.anchor_definition: island center at local sea level

requirements: open water around the full footprint
unobstructed northern sightline toward Pallet Town
no required route or gym progression through the island

access.recommended: early optional swim or ordinary boat
access.clue: broken dock and boat debris aligned with the Pallet shoreline
access.revisit: later water mounts make the return trip faster; no hard gate

structure.implementation: generated island function plus copied MIT donor NBT
structure.modifications: jigsaws resolved after placement, donor loot replaced, small roof-edge tear

reward.recommended: per-player level 5-7 Pichu encounter plus a lore collectible
reward.claim_model: per-player once EXP-006 and EXP-007 prove encounter and progression state

lore_cues: front path ends abruptly at the water
one upper corner is torn away rather than naturally ruined
household debris points back toward Pallet Town
calcite and amethyst scar crosses geology that does not match the coast
one surviving tree and broken fence make the fragment feel inhabited, then abandoned

reference.use: layout and mood reference; not a block-for-block blueprint
